# AG Grid Documentation

> AG Grid is a high-performance, feature-rich JavaScript data grid component supporting React, Angular, Vue 3, and vanilla JavaScript. Available as Community (MIT licensed) and Enterprise (commercial) versions.

## Framework-Specific Documentation

- **[llms-react.txt](llms-react.txt)** - React Data Grid documentation
- **[llms-angular.txt](llms-angular.txt)** - Angular Data Grid documentation
- **[llms-vue.txt](llms-vue.txt)** - Vue 3 Data Grid documentation
- **[llms-javascript.txt](llms-javascript.txt)** - JavaScript Data Grid documentation
- **[llms-core.txt](llms-core.txt)** - Core concepts shared across all frameworks (Grid API, Enterprise features, Theming, etc.)

## Project Overview

AG Grid provides:
- Virtual DOM rendering for high performance with large datasets
- Column-based configuration with sorting, filtering, editing, and custom rendering
- Multiple row models: Client-Side, Server-Side, Infinite, and Viewport
- Enterprise features: Row Grouping, Pivoting, Aggregation, Tree Data, Master/Detail, Excel Export, Integrated Charts, Sparklines
- Framework-specific wrappers for React, Angular, and Vue 3
- Modular architecture for bundle size optimization

## Quick Start

### React
```bash
npm install ag-grid-react
```

### Angular
```bash
npm install ag-grid-angular
```

### Vue 3
```bash
npm install ag-grid-vue3
```

### JavaScript
```bash
npm install ag-grid-community
```

### Enterprise Features
```bash
npm install ag-grid-enterprise
```

## Community vs Enterprise

| Feature | Community | Enterprise |
|---------|-----------|------------|
| Basic Grid | ✓ | ✓ |
| Sorting | ✓ | ✓ |
| Filtering (Text, Number, Date) | ✓ | ✓ |
| Editing | ✓ | ✓ |
| Selection | ✓ | ✓ |
| Pagination | ✓ | ✓ |
| Column Pinning | ✓ | ✓ |
| Column Groups | ✓ | ✓ |
| Row Grouping | - | ✓ |
| Pivoting | - | ✓ |
| Aggregation | - | ✓ |
| Tree Data | - | ✓ |
| Master/Detail | - | ✓ |
| Set Filter | - | ✓ |
| Excel Export | - | ✓ |
| Integrated Charts | - | ✓ |
| Sparklines | - | ✓ |
| Clipboard | - | ✓ |
| Range Selection | - | ✓ |
| Undo/Redo | - | ✓ |
| Context Menu | - | ✓ |

## License (Enterprise)

```javascript
import { LicenseManager } from 'ag-grid-enterprise';
LicenseManager.setLicenseKey('your-license-key');
```

Or via environment variable:
```bash
AG_GRID_LICENSE_KEY=your-license-key
```
